items.title: Make PASS evidence envelopes total and contradiction-safe
items.context: Use the B-914f F-010/F-012 history and B-ebe4 delivery_check_set unverified+verifiedBy false PASS as concrete regressions. Define one normalized PASS predicate/envelope, reject missing/unknown/nonzero/conflicting fields, and generate field mutation plus pairwise contradiction tests. Keep CLI schema and handler/gate enforcement aligned.

items.title: Block production test seams from reaching side-effect sinks
items.context: Use B-914f F-011 as regression: an env-derived smoke seam flowed into writeFileSync arbitrary path. Add a bounded static/AST guard over production core/handlers that rejects SMOKE/TEST env switches and env-derived flows into write/rm/rename/exec/spawn sinks; race tests should use temp-repo pure helpers or capability-limited injected callbacks.
